statements.impact_statement: proc-macro-error 1.0.4 is unmaintained, which the advisory reports in place of a vulnerability. Only the procedural macros of static-automata-macros, static-regular-grammar and str-newtype-derive use it, so it runs while the broker compiles and none of its code is in the binary. The newest releases of static-automata-macros and static-regular-grammar still depend on it.

rustls-pemfile 2.2.0 is unmaintained, which the advisory reports in place of a vulnerability. rumqttc 0.25.1, the only crate linking it, calls it only to read certificate files for a TlsConfiguration::Simple, and the broker never builds one, handing rumqttc a ready rustls client configuration instead.

rustls-webpki 0.102 compares only the first CRL distribution point of a certificate when it checks revocation, so a revoked certificate can pass when unknown revocation status is allowed. The broker never runs that check. rumqttc 0.25.1, the only crate linking rustls-webpki 0.102, names it only as the type of an error variant that nothing constructs and calls none of its functions, and the broker verifies every certificate with rustls-webpki 0.103.16 or later, which is patched, and with no revocation lists.

The broker never runs that verification. rumqttc 0.25.1, the only crate linking rustls-webpki 0.102, names it only as the type of an error variant that nothing constructs and calls none of its functions, and the broker verifies every certificate with rustls-webpki 0.103.16 or later, which rejects URI name constraints.
